notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide and docs/evidence/card.md at e7ed622. This replaces the undocumented entry from 0.1.78+2 (a JSDoc summary and one slim example that set Color Mode): Card now has a designer guide. The guide's Sources note was checked on 28 October 2026 on the installed build itself (jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02, Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October), so items citing it carry that build. The evidence's dbe0e02 section (#343, verified 27 October on dbe0e02, closed) replaces its 19 October sections (0.1.78-a116616) where they differ: false slots leave no band, the card has hover, pressed, focus and disabled looks, it is white (Neutral) by default, testID reaches the root, a raw-string header no longer errors, and Code Connect maps the slots. None of those superseded sentences is used here. Installed Card.tsx still matches every guide sentence used here, read from source, not run: variant defaults to default and slim never renders media; header, media and children each render only when not null, false or an empty string; the header is a row and the content a column, both padded by the card/content/padding tokens; the media box is full width at mediaAspectRatio (default 154 / 116) with overflow hidden; the card merges AppearanceBrand Neutral under the caller's modes and reads no theme provider; modes are cloned into header, media and children; without onPress the root is a View (a group named by accessibilityLabel on the web), with onPress a Pressable button with opacity 0.92 on hover, 0.8 pressed, 0.5 disabled and a #0c0d10 focus ring, and disabled does nothing without onPress; Card.Title is 16 px weight 900 clamped at 3 lines (line height raised from 18 to 20), Card.SupportText 12 px with no clamp, both plain Text with no heading role; an Image given both width and height drops its own 16 : 9 ratio. The card/* token values were looked up with the package's own getVariableByName (the component was not rendered): fills Neutral white, Primary #fef4e5, Secondary #f6f3ff, Tertiary #ecf7ff, positive #dbf0d9, warning #ffe3d6, negative #ffe0de; radius 12; padding 12; Gap S 4/4, M 14/18, L 23/23, None 0/0; Card Container Plain transparent with radius and padding 0; Page type SubPage and context 8 Section a #ebebed border. No guide sentence is contradicted. The generated AppearanceBrand fact gives the collection's default, Primary; Card sets Neutral itself, so an evidence fact records Neutral as Card's default. Not recorded as a rule: the Sources sentence “The card doesn’t read the app’s theme, so pass modes on the card or place it in a Coin stack”, because the building rules keep Color Mode off components; it is kept on the modes fact. avoidWhen is empty: the guide names no case to avoid Card and no component to use instead. The evidence quotes Biscuit's Card.mdx (not a payment result, a list row or a fixed-size shortcut), but the guide doesn't say it. The media rule (an Image 100% wide and tall fills the slot) comes from the evidence's Hosting note; it describes the slot, not only the guide's own examples, and the package's Image defaults to 16 : 9, which leaves a band in the 154:116 slot. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every Card, Image, Text, Title and stack), no AppearanceBrand Neutral (now the card's own default), and no Slot gap on the In context VStack. The status example sets Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative, the guide's status tint; negative is used because positive would repeat AppearanceSystem's default. Widths are layout, as in the guide: 200 px through style (Figma's width) and flex 1 for the two offers in a row. The guide's logo and photo are docs assets, so examples pass { uri } placeholders on example.com standing for the app's own images. Copy is the guide's own (JioFinance, Jio Payments Bank, Digital gold, Fixed deposit). Left out of examples: the playground, the fills Primary, Secondary and Tertiary, Card Container Plain, Page type SubPage, context 8 Section and Gap M and L (modes that only change the look, which the building rules leave at their defaults), mediaAspectRatio 1, Disabled, Long title, the In context readout (“No offer opened”, page copy) and the Don'ts. Not recorded: numberOfLines on Card.Title and Card.SupportText beyond their facts, testID and the other inherited View props, Page type JioPlus's support-text colour (evidence only), and style beyond width. Not recorded as gaps, per the pack's rules: dark mode and screen-reader names; and #343, fixed and verified on the installed build.

evidenceFacts.name: AppearanceBrand
evidenceFacts.description: Sets the card's fill. With no modes, or Color Mode Light only, the fill is Neutral white (#ffffff); AppearanceBrand Primary, on the card or from a VStack, gives cream #fef4e5.
evidenceFacts.quote: With no modes, or Color Mode Light only, the fill is `#ffffff` (Neutral); AppearanceBrand Primary, on the card or from a VStack, gives `#fef4e5`.

evidenceFacts.name: modes
evidenceFacts.description: The card doesn't read the app's theme: its modes come from this prop or from a Coin stack it is placed in.

evidenceFacts.name: header

evidenceFacts.name: onPress
evidenceFacts.description: A pressable card dims to opacity 0.92 on hover and 0.8 while pressed (mouse and Space), and shows a 1 px #0c0d10 focus outline at offset 2, which also shows after a mouse click until blur.
